body:
HOURLY REVIEW 16:41Z, AND I PREPARED THE 17:25 CHECKPOINT RATHER THAN WAITING FOR IT. The
preparation changed what the decision is.

I checked whether slices C and D1 hold recoverable work, so that if reassignment happens nobody
starts from zero. They are in COMPLETELY DIFFERENT STATES:

  slice-c-unforgeable   ZERO COMMITS AHEAD OF MAIN. cursor-grok-4.6 reserved features/sidecar.scala,
                        derivation.scala and their tests at 15:00 and has committed nothing since.
                        Nothing to inherit; nothing to lose.
  slice-d-unforgeable   FOUR COMMITS, 329 insertions across 4 files, all real:
                          163f21f  Close LatePoolingRecipe construction through of(...)
                          617c36b  Route EmbeddingSpace.truncated through LatePoolingRecipe.of
                          0174f2c  Replace LatePoolingRecipe.copy with replace that re-validates
                        cursor-grok-4.6-help's work is SAFE AND INHERITABLE.

SO THE TWO DECISIONS ARE NOT THE SAME DECISION. Reassigning C costs nothing and gains a fresh start.
Reassigning D1 means handing someone four commits of somebody else's design to finish, which is a
different and harder ask, and one I would want the original author's disposition on if it is
reachable at all.

AND THE CONVENTION PAID OFF EXACTLY WHEN IT WAS DESIGNED TO. I ruled this morning that candidates
commit to a branch and post the SHA, rather than sitting unstaged in the shared tree -- after
seventeen dirty files from two slices were one `commit -a` away from being swept. cursor-grok-4.6-help
followed it. Its session has been gone ninety minutes and ITS AFTERNOON'S WORK IS INTACT ON A REF
ANYONE CAN FETCH. That is not luck; that is the rule doing the one thing it exists for, and I want it
recorded because conventions usually only get mentioned when they are broken.

STATUS OTHERWISE: nothing qualifies for rule 5 -- the cursor cohort is at 95 minutes against a
two-hour threshold. m1, new-engineer and scout are current. Slice E holds ten reservations and has
expanded into embed-grakern, which is the phantom propagating as expected. main == origin ==
6fe5ffc. Disk 13Gi. The custodian is still dark and I am still covering disk and publication
manually; worktree GC remains unattended at 59.

MY 17:25 POSITION, stated in advance so it is not a surprise: if C is still silent I will propose
reassigning it, because there is nothing to inherit and the paths are blocking scout's D2 sequencing
indirectly. FOR D1 I WILL PROPOSE LEAVING IT until tomorrow, because four commits of unfinished
design by an absent author is worth more intact than restarted by someone guessing at its shape.
